events.otoroshi.io.DataExporter.description: A data exporter: it exports the events of otoroshi (calls, alerts, audit, health checks, traffic captures, ...) to an external system. Each exporter runs its own pipeline: the events are filtered, projected, grouped in batches and sent to its destination, set by its `type` and described by its `config`

example.name: Access logs to Elasticsearch
example.desc: Access logs to Elasticsearch, managed by the platform team

DataExporterConfig.console.description: A data exporter of type `console`: the events are printed on the standard output of otoroshi, for tests

type.description: The type of the exporter: `console`, the events are printed on the standard output of otoroshi, for tests

enabled.description: Whether the exporter runs. A disabled exporter keeps its settings but exports nothing. Defaults to false

id.description: The unique id of the exporter, the key it is stored under and the `{id}` of its urls in the admin api. The templates generate `data_exporter_<uuid>` (`data_exporter_<env>_<uuid>` outside the `prod` environment)

name.description: The display name of the exporter, shown in the backoffice

desc.description: A description of the exporter. Defaults to `--`
desc.example: Alerts on stdout, managed by the platform team

metadata.description: Free key/value metadata of the exporter

tags.description: Free tags of the exporter, to search and sort it

bufferSize.description: The maximum number of events waiting to be exported. Once it is reached, the oldest waiting events are dropped. Defaults to 5000

jsonWorkers.description: The number of events turned into json (and enriched) in parallel. Defaults to 1

sendWorkers.description: The number of batches sent in parallel. Defaults to 5

groupSize.description: The maximum number of events of a batch: a batch is sent once it is full or once `groupDuration` is elapsed. Defaults to 100

groupDuration.description: The maximum delay before a batch is sent, in milliseconds, even when it is not full. Defaults to 30000

projection.description: The fields of the events that are exported, as a json object: `{"field": true}` keeps a field, operators like `$at`, `$path`, `$jq` or `$date_from_unix_fmt` compute new ones (see the documentation of the data exporters). An empty object exports the whole events

customFilter.description: A custom filter, applied after `filtering`: the events it refuses are not exported. Null for none

customTransform.description: A custom transformation of the events, applied before they are exported. Null for none

example.name: Alerts on stdout
example.desc: Alerts on stdout, managed by the platform team

DataExporterConfigFiltering.description: The events a data exporter keeps. An event is exported when it matches one of the `include` filters (or when there is none) and none of the `exclude` filters. A filter is a json object the event has to match, field by field, with operators like `$wildcard`, `$regex`, `$gt`, `$in`, `$contains`, `$or`, `$not` (see the documentation of the data exporters)

include.description: The filters of the events to export, one of them has to match. Empty to export every event

items.description: A filter the event has to match

exclude.description: The filters of the events not to export, an event matching one of them is dropped

items.description: A filter the event must not match

CustomDataExporterRefConfig.description: A custom filter or transformation of the events of a data exporter, done by a plugin, a wasm plugin or a workflow

kind.description: What `ref` designates: a custom data exporter filter or transformer plugin (`plugin`), a wasm plugin (`wasm`) or a workflow (`workflow`). Lowercased when read, defaults to `plugin`

ref.description: The reference of the plugin, the id of the wasm plugin or the id of the workflow. A filter or transformation with an empty ref is read as null

config.description: The configuration given to the plugin, the wasm plugin or the workflow

ConsoleSettings.description: The settings of a console exporter, which prints the events on the standard output of otoroshi: there are none, the settings are always an empty object

ExporterRef.description: The settings of a custom exporter, implemented by a plugin of type exporter

ref.description: The reference of the exporter plugin, `cp:` followed by its class name for a plugin of the classpath

config.description: The configuration given to the exporter plugin

MetricSettings.description: A metric a custom metrics or OTLP metrics exporter updates for each event it exports: the events it applies to, the value it reads and its labels

id.description: The name of the metric: the one it is exposed under by otoroshi (custom metrics exporter) or sent to the collector with (OTLP metrics exporter), tagged with the `tags` of the exporter and its own `labels`

selector.description: The path of the numeric value of the event the metric is computed from (for instance `duration`). A counter without selector counts the events, a histogram or a timer without selector records nothing

kind.description: The kind of metric: a counter incremented by the value (or by one), a histogram of the values, or a timer of the values in milliseconds. Defaults to `Counter`

eventType.description: The events the metric is computed from: the ones whose `@type` (or `alert`) is this value. Null for every event. A missing value is read as `AlertEvent`

labels.description: The labels of the metric: each key is the path of a value of the event (`$at` stands for `@`), each value is the name of the label holding it

MetricsSettings.description: The settings of a metrics exporter: it feeds the metrics of the calls (counts, durations, sizes) exposed by otoroshi (Prometheus, ...), labelled with values taken from the events

labels.description: The labels of the metrics: each key is the path of a value of the event (`$at` stands for `@`), each value is the name of the label holding it

CustomMetricsSettings.description: The settings of a custom metrics exporter: it computes the metrics it lists from the events and adds them to the metrics exposed by otoroshi (Prometheus, ...)

tags.description: Tags added to every metric

metrics.description: The metrics updated for each exported event, each with its name, its kind, the events it applies to and its labels

OtlpSettings.description: The connection to an OpenTelemetry collector (OTLP)

gzip.description: Whether the payloads are compressed with gzip. Defaults to false

grpc.description: Whether OTLP over gRPC is used instead of OTLP over http. Defaults to false

endpoint.description: The url the metrics or the logs are sent to: the full url of the OTLP http endpoint, path included (`/v1/logs`, `/v1/metrics`), or the url of the gRPC endpoint (like `http://otel-collector:4317`) when `grpc` is true

timeout.description: The timeout of a call, in milliseconds. 0 or missing is read as 30000

client_cert.description: The id of the certificate presented to the collector as a client certificate, null for none

trusted_cert.description: The id of the certificate trusted to validate the certificate of the collector, null for the default trust store

headers.description: The http headers sent to the collector

max_batch.description: The maximum number of log records sent in one call, for the logs exporter. Defaults to 1000

max_duration.description: The delay between two sends, in milliseconds: the interval the metrics are pushed at, or the longest wait before the pending log records are sent. 0 or missing is read as 30000

OtlpMetricsExporterSettings.description: The settings of an OTLP metrics exporter: it computes the metrics it lists from the events and sends them to an OpenTelemetry collector

type.description: Written by otoroshi, not read back

tags.description: Tags added to every metric

metrics.description: The metrics computed from the events. A metric that cannot be read is dropped

otlp.description: The collector the metrics are sent to

OtlpLogsExporterSettings.description: The settings of an OTLP logs exporter: each event is sent as a log record (of severity ERROR for an alert, INFO otherwise) to an OpenTelemetry collector

type.description: Written by otoroshi, not read back

otlp.description: The collector the logs are sent to

WasmExporterSettings.description: The settings of a wasm exporter: the events are given to the `export_events` function of a wasm plugin

params.description: Parameters given to the wasm function with the events

wasm_ref.description: The id of the wasm plugin (`plugins.otoroshi.io/v1/wasm-plugins`). A blank value is read as null, and nothing is exported then

WorkflowCallSettings.description: The settings of a workflow exporter: each batch of events is given to a workflow, as `events` in its input (with the exporter as `config`)

HttpCallSettings.description: The settings of an http exporter: each batch of events is sent in an http call whose body is built from a template

url.description: The url each batch of events is sent to

method.description: The http method of the call. Defaults to `GET`

headers.description: The http headers sent with each call, for instance its `Content-Type` or an `Authorization` header

cookies.description: Cookies of the call. They are kept with the settings, but the exporter does not send them with its calls

name.description: The name of the cookie. Mandatory: settings holding a cookie without name cannot be read

value.description: The value of the cookie. Mandatory: settings holding a cookie without value cannot be read

path.description: The `Path` attribute of the cookie, null for none

domain.description: The `Domain` attribute of the cookie, null for none

http_only.description: Whether the cookie is http only. Defaults to false

max_age.description: The max age of the cookie, in seconds

secure.description: Whether the cookie is secure. Defaults to false

body.description: The template of the body of the call, sent once its placeholders are replaced: `${events}` or `${events.stringify}` by the events as a json array, `${events.prettify}` and `${events.nd_prettify}` by the same array pretty printed, `${events.nd_stringify}` by the json of each event separated by an empty line, `${events.length}` by their number, `${now}` by the current timestamp in milliseconds, `${now_epoch}` by the current timestamp in seconds and `${now_str}` by the current date. Empty when absent

timeout.description: The timeout of a call, in milliseconds. Defaults to 60000

tls_config.description: The tls settings of the calls to the url

SplunkCallSettings.description: The settings of a Splunk exporter: the events are sent to a Splunk HTTP Event Collector (HEC)

token.description: The token of the event collector, sent as `Authorization: Splunk <token>`

url.description: The url of the HTTP Event Collector endpoint the events are posted to, like `https://<host>:8088/services/collector`

headers.description: Additional http headers of the calls

timeout.description: The timeout of a call, in milliseconds. Defaults to 60000

tls_config.description: The tls settings of the calls to the event collector

source_type.description: The `sourcetype` of the events. Not written when unset. The legacy `sourceType` key is read too

index.description: The Splunk index of the events. Not written when unset

fields.description: The `fields` added to every event. Not written when empty

DatadogCallSettings.description: The settings of a Datadog exporter: the events are sent as logs to the Datadog logs intake

token.description: The Datadog api key, sent as `DD-API-KEY`

url.description: The url of the logs intake. Defaults to `https://http-intake.logs.datadoghq.eu/api/v2/logs`

headers.description: Additional http headers of the calls

timeout.description: The timeout of a call, in milliseconds. Defaults to 60000

tls_config.description: The tls settings of the calls to the logs intake

ddsource.description: The `ddsource` of the logs, `otoroshi` when unset. Not written when unset

ddtags.description: The `ddtags` of the logs. Not written when unset

service.description: The `service` of the logs, the name of the route of the event when unset. Not written when unset

hostname.description: The `hostname` of the logs, the name of the otoroshi cluster when unset. Not written when unset

NewRelicCallSettings.description: The settings of a New Relic exporter: the events are sent to the New Relic log api

token.description: The New Relic license key, sent as `Api-Key`

url.description: The url of the log api. Defaults to `https://log-api.eu.newrelic.com/log/v1`

headers.description: Additional http headers of the calls

timeout.description: The timeout of a call, in milliseconds. Defaults to 60000

tls_config.description: The tls settings of the calls to the log api

logtype.description: The `logtype` of the logs, the `@type` of the event when unset. Not written when unset

service.description: The `service` of the logs, `otoroshi` when unset. Not written when unset

hostname.description: Not used, the `hostname` of the logs is the host called. Not written when unset

PulsarConfig.description: The settings of a Pulsar exporter: the events are sent to an Apache Pulsar topic

uri.description: The service url of the Pulsar cluster: `pulsar://<host>:6650`, or `pulsar+ssl://<host>:6651` over tls

tlsTrustCertsFilePath.description: The path of a file of trusted certificates given to the Pulsar client. Only used when `mtls` of `mtlsConfig` is true. Null for none

tenant.description: The Pulsar tenant of the topic: the events are sent to `persistent://<tenant>/<namespace>/<topic>`

namespace.description: The Pulsar namespace of the topic, within the tenant

topic.description: The name of the topic the events are sent to, within the namespace

token.description: A token to authenticate to Pulsar, null for none. Not used when `mtls` of `mtlsConfig` is true. A blank value is read as null

username.description: The user to authenticate to Pulsar with (basic authentication, when there is no token), null for none. Not used when `mtls` of `mtlsConfig` is true. A blank value is read as null

password.description: The password of the user, null for none. A blank value is read as null

mtlsConfig.description: The tls settings of the connection to Pulsar: when `mtls` is true, the certificates of otoroshi are used

JMSExporterSettings.description: The settings of a JMS exporter: the events are sent to a JMS queue or topic (ActiveMQ)

url.description: The url of the broker. Defaults to `tcp://localhost:61616`

name.description: The name of the queue or the topic. Defaults to `otoroshi-events`

topic.description: Whether `name` is a topic (true) or a queue (false). Defaults to true

username.description: The user to connect with, null for none. A blank value is read as null

password.description: The password of the user, null for none. A blank value is read as null

FileSettings.description: The settings of a file exporter: the events are appended to a local file, as newline delimited json

path.description: The path of the file the events are appended to, its directories created when missing. The placeholders `{date}` (`yyyy-MM-dd`), `{year}`, `{month}`, `{day}`, `{hour}` and `{time}` are replaced at each write, to start a new file per day or per hour

maxFileSize.description: The maximum size of the file, in bytes. Once reached, the file is renamed with a timestamp and a new one is started

maxNumberOfFile.description: The maximum number of files kept, the oldest ones being deleted. Null (or 0) to keep them all

S3Configuration.description: The connection to an S3 compatible object storage, and the object the data is written to

bucket.description: The name of the bucket the objects are written to

endpoint.description: The url of the S3 api

region.description: The region of the bucket. Defaults to `eu-west-1`

access.description: The access key id of the credentials the requests are signed with

secret.description: The secret access key of the credentials, paired with `access`

key.description: The key (path) of the objects in the bucket: the exporters use it as the prefix of the names of the files they upload. A leading `/` is removed when read

chunkSize.description: The size of the chunks of a multipart upload, in bytes. Defaults to 8388608 (8 MB)

v4auth.description: Whether the requests are signed with AWS signature v4 (v2 otherwise). Defaults to true

writeEvery.description: The delay between two uploads of the current file, in milliseconds. Defaults to 60000

acl.description: The canned ACL of the objects written. The names of the canned ACLs (`Private`, `PublicRead`, ...) are read too, an unknown value is read as `private`

pathStyleAccess.description: Whether the bucket is addressed in the path of the urls rather than in their host. Defaults to false

S3ExporterSettings.description: The settings of an S3 exporter: the events are written to files, as newline delimited json, uploaded to an S3 compatible object storage

maxFileSize.description: The maximum size of a file, in bytes. A new file is started once it is reached. Defaults to 10485760 (10 MB)

maxNumberOfFile.description: The maximum number of files kept, the oldest ones being deleted. Null (or 0) to keep them all

GoReplayFileSettings.description: The settings of a GoReplay file exporter: the captured traffic (`TrafficCaptureEvent`, emitted by the routes with `capture` enabled) is written to a local file in the GoReplay format (`.gor`)

path.description: The path of the capture file, its directories created when missing. The placeholders `{date}` (`yyyy-MM-dd`), `{year}`, `{month}`, `{day}`, `{hour}` and `{time}` are replaced at each write, to start a new file per day or per hour

maxFileSize.description: The maximum size of a capture file, in bytes. A new file is started once it is reached. Defaults to 10485760 (10 MB)

captureRequests.description: Whether the requests are captured. Defaults to true

captureResponses.description: Whether the responses are captured. Defaults to false

preferBackendRequest.description: Whether the captured request is the one otoroshi sent to the backend rather than the one the client sent. Defaults to false

preferBackendResponse.description: Whether the captured response is the one the backend sent rather than the one otoroshi sent to the client. Defaults to false

methods.description: The http methods of the calls captured. Empty for every method

GoReplayS3Settings.description: The settings of a GoReplay S3 exporter: the captured traffic (`TrafficCaptureEvent`, emitted by the routes with `capture` enabled) is written in the GoReplay format (`.gor`) to an S3 compatible object storage

s3.description: Where the capture files are uploaded

maxFileSize.description: The maximum size of a capture file, in bytes. A new file is started once it is reached. Defaults to 10485760 (10 MB)

captureRequests.description: Whether the requests are captured. Defaults to true

captureResponses.description: Whether the responses are captured. Defaults to false

preferBackendRequest.description: Whether the captured request is the one otoroshi sent to the backend rather than the one the client sent. Defaults to false

preferBackendResponse.description: Whether the captured response is the one the backend sent rather than the one otoroshi sent to the client. Defaults to false

methods.description: The http methods of the calls captured. Empty for every method

PostgresExporterSettings.description: The settings of a PostgreSQL exporter: the events are inserted as json in a table of a PostgreSQL database

uri.description: A connection uri, like `postgresql://user:password@host:5432/database`, used instead of the other connection settings when set. A blank value is read as null

host.description: The host of the database. Defaults to `localhost`

port.description: The port of the database. Defaults to 5432

database.description: The name of the database. Defaults to `otoroshi`

user.description: The user connecting to the database. Defaults to `otoroshi`

password.description: The password of the user. Defaults to `otoroshi`

schema.description: The schema of the table. Defaults to `otoroshi`

table.description: The table the events are inserted in. Defaults to `otoroshi_events`

pool_size.description: The maximum number of connections to the database. Defaults to 5

ssl.description: Whether the connection uses tls. Defaults to false

retention_days.description: How long the events are kept, in days: older events are deleted (checked at most once per hour). 0 or less keeps them forever. Defaults to 0

TCPExporterSettings.description: The settings of a TCP exporter: the events are sent as json lines over a TCP connection (or a unix socket), optionally over tls

host.description: The host to connect to, or the path of the socket when `unix_socket` is true. Defaults to `127.0.0.1`

port.description: The port to connect to. Defaults to 6514

unix_socket.description: Whether `host` is the path of a unix socket. Defaults to false

connect_timeout.description: The timeout of the connection, in milliseconds. Defaults to 10000

tls.description: The tls settings of the connection, used when `enabled` is true

UDPExporterSettings.description: The settings of a UDP exporter: the events are sent as json datagrams (or to a unix socket)

host.description: The host to send to, or the path of the socket when `unix_socket` is true. Defaults to `127.0.0.1`

port.description: The port to send to. Defaults to 514

unix_socket.description: Whether `host` is the path of a unix socket. Defaults to false

connect_timeout.description: The timeout of the connection, in milliseconds. Defaults to 10000

SyslogExporterSettings.description: The settings of a syslog exporter: the events are sent as syslog messages, over TCP (optionally over tls), over UDP, or to a unix socket

tcp.description: Whether the messages are sent over TCP. Defaults to false

udp.description: Whether the messages are sent over UDP, when `tcp` is false. Defaults to true

host.description: The host of the syslog server, or the path of the socket when `unix_socket` is true. Defaults to `/var/run/syslog`

port.description: The port of the syslog server. Defaults to 514

unix_socket.description: Whether `host` is the path of a unix socket. Defaults to true

connect_timeout.description: The timeout of the connection, in milliseconds. Defaults to 10000

tls.description: The tls settings of the TCP connection, used when `enabled` is true
